title: "Final Group Project"
output: word_document
date: "2026-05-07"
---

```{r}
# Load the data
library(tidyverse)
library(nflreadr)

# 1. Load 2023 Regular Season Stats
team_yards_2023 <- load_player_stats(2023) %>%
  filter(season_type == "REG") %>%
  group_by(team) %>%
  summarize(
    total_pass_yards = sum(passing_yards, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_rush_yards = sum(rushing_yards, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Official 2023 Standings for all 32 teams
official_2023_all <- data.frame(
  team = c("BAL", "BUF", "KC", "HOU", "CLE", "MIA", "PIT", "JAX", "IND", "LV", 
           "DEN", "CIN", "NYJ", "TEN", "LAC", "NE", "DAL", "DET", "SF", "PHI", 
           "LAR", "TB", "GB", "NO", "SEA", "MIN", "CHI", "ATL", "NYG", "WAS", 
           "ARI", "CAR"),
  W = c(13, 11, 11, 10, 11, 11, 10, 9, 9, 8, 8, 9, 7, 6, 5, 4, 
        12, 12, 12, 11, 10, 9, 9, 9, 9, 7, 7, 7, 6, 4, 4, 2),
  L = c(4, 6, 6, 7, 6, 6, 7, 8, 8, 9, 9, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 
        5, 5, 5, 6, 7, 8, 8, 8, 8, 10, 10, 10, 11, 13, 13, 15),
  T = rep(0, 32) # No ties occurred in the 2023 regular season
) %>%
  mutate(Win_Pct = (W + 0.5 * T) / (W + L + T))

# 3. Final Join
final_data_2023 <- team_yards_2023 %>%
  inner_join(official_2023_all, by = "team")

# Hypothesis testing 
model_2023 <- lm(Win_Pct ~ total_pass_yards + total_rush_yards, data = final_data_2023)
summary(model_2023)

# Simple Scatterplot for Passing 
plot(final_data_2023$total_pass_yards, final_data_2023$Win_Pct,
     main = "Passing Yards vs. Win Percentage",
     xlab = "Total Passing Yards",
     ylab = "Winning Percentage",
     pch = 19, col = "blue")
model_pass <- lm(Win_Pct ~ total_pass_yards, data = final_data_2023)
abline(model_pass, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# Simple Scatterplot for Rushing
plot(final_data_2023$total_rush_yards, final_data_2023$Win_Pct,
     main = "Rushing Yards vs. Win Percentage",
     xlab = "Total Rushing Yards",
     ylab = "Winning Percentage",
     pch = 19, col = "darkorange")
model_rush <- lm(Win_Pct ~ total_rush_yards, data = final_data_2023)
abline(model_rush, col = "red", lwd = 2)


pairs(final_data_2023[, c("Win_Pct", "total_pass_yards", "total_rush_yards")],
      main = "Scatterplot Matrix of Team Data")

# Create 'High' vs 'Low' groups based on the Median 
final_data_2023$pass_group <- ifelse(final_data_2023$total_pass_yards > median(final_data_2023$total_pass_yards), "High Passing", "Low Passing")
final_data_2023$rush_group <- ifelse(final_data_2023$total_rush_yards > median(final_data_2023$total_rush_yards), "High Rushing", "Low Rushing")

# Boxplot: Win % by Passing Group
boxplot(Win_Pct ~ pass_group, data = final_data_2023,
        main = "Win % by Passing Performance",
        xlab = "Passing Volume", ylab = "Win %",
        col = c("blue", "lightblue"))

# Boxplot: Win % by Rushing Group
boxplot(Win_Pct ~ rush_group, data = final_data_2023,
        main = "Win % by Rushing Performance",
        xlab = "Rushing Volume", ylab = "Win %",
        col = c("orange", "wheat"))

# T-test for Passing Groups
pass_ttest <- t.test(Win_Pct ~ pass_group, data = final_data_2023)
print("--- T-Test: High vs Low Passing ---")
print(pass_ttest)

# T-test for Rushing Groups
rush_ttest <- t.test(Win_Pct ~ rush_group, data = final_data_2023)
print("--- T-Test: High vs Low Rushing ---")
print(rush_ttest)

# Add playoff teams for ANOVA 
playoff_teams <- c("BAL", "BUF", "KC", "HOU", "CLE", "MIA", "PIT", 
                   "DAL", "DET", "SF", "PHI", "LAR", "TB", "GB")

final_data_2023 <- final_data_2023 %>%
  mutate(is_playoff = ifelse(team %in% playoff_teams, "Playoff", "Non-Playoff"))

inal_data_2023 <- final_data_2023 %>%
  mutate(is_playoff = ifelse(team %in% playoff_teams, "Playoff", "Non-Playoff"))

# Two-Way ANOVA: Passing Group and Playoff Status 
# Two-Way ANOVA: Passing Group and Playoff Status
anova_interaction <- aov(Win_Pct ~ pass_group * is_playoff, data = final_data_2023)
summary(anova_interaction)

# Two-Way ANOVA for Passing & Playoff Status
anova_pass_playoff <- aov(Win_Pct ~ pass_group * is_playoff, data = final_data_2023)
print("--- ANOVA: Passing vs Playoff Status ---")
summary(anova_pass_playoff)

# Calculate the means for the passing groups
pass_means <- tapply(final_data_2023$Win_Pct, final_data_2023$pass_group, mean)

# Create the Barplot
barplot(pass_means, 
        main = "Mean Win % by Passing Volume",
        ylab = "Average Win Percentage",
        col = c("lightblue", "royalblue"),
        ylim = c(0, 0.8)) # Sets the y-axis to show 0% to 80%

#. Two-Way ANOVA for Rushing & Playoff Status
anova_rush_playoff <- aov(Win_Pct ~ rush_group * is_playoff, data = final_data_2023)
print("--- ANOVA: Rushing vs Playoff Status ---")
summary(anova_rush_playoff)

# Calculate the means for the rushing groups
rush_means <- tapply(final_data_2023$Win_Pct, final_data_2023$rush_group, mean)

# Create the Barplot
barplot(rush_means, 
        main = "Mean Win % by Rushing Volume",
        ylab = "Average Win Percentage",
        col = c("darkorange", "wheat"),
        ylim = c(0, 0.8))

# Histogram for Win Percentage 
hist(final_data_2023$Win_Pct, 
     breaks = 8, 
     col = "gray90", 
     border = "black",
     main = "Distribution of NFL Win Percentages (2023)",
     xlab = "Win Percentage",
     ylab = "Number of Teams")

# Add a vertical line for the mean
abline(v = mean(final_data_2023$Win_Pct), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

# ScatterPlot for Win Percentage

# This creates a scale from 'lightblue' (Low Win %) to 'darkblue' (High Win %)
color_function <- colorRampPalette(c('lightblue', 'darkblue'))
final_data_2023$color_idx <- color_function(10)[as.numeric(cut(final_data_2023$Win_Pct, breaks = 10))]
# Generate the Scatterplot
plot(final_data_2023$total_pass_yards, final_data_2023$total_rush_yards,
     pch = 19, # Solid circles
     col = final_data_2023$color_idx,
     main = "2023 NFL: Passing vs. Rushing Yardage",
     xlab = "Total Passing Yards",
     ylab = "Total Rushing Yards",
     cex = 1.5) # Makes the dots slightly larger

# Add Team Labels
text(final_data_2023$total_pass_yards, final_data_2023$total_rush_yards, 
     labels = final_data_2023$team, 
     pos = 3, # Positions text above the point
     cex = 0.7)

# Add a Legend
legend("topright", 
       legend = c("High Win %", "Low Win %"), 
       fill = c("darkblue", "lightblue"), 
       cex = 0.8, 
       title = "Success Level")


# This creates four quadrants (High/High, Low/Low, etc.) matching your ANOVA groups
abline(v = median(final_data_2023$total_pass_yards), col = "gray", lty = 2)
abline(h = median(final_data_2023$total_rush_yards), col = "gray", lty = 2)
```
